exact_statement: For every actual nonempty cube support U of mass p, let f=1-2*1_U and transport its original connected-component labels through an invertible affine INPUT map T, without output-character multiplication. Let gamma_A count directed internal edges across inherited labels in the reset chart. Then sum_l 4E_A(g_l composed with T)=I_A(f composed with T)+2gamma_A; W_singleton=Inf_i/2+gamma_i; and max_proper (W_A-gamma_A)/(|A|p)=max_i Inf_i/(2p) for n>=2. For a nonincreasing-influence input reset with release rho, its signed labelled release is rho_L=rho-2gamma_all. With old booked debit0<=u<=rho, unused R=rho-u, 2gamma_A<=R and W_A>=|A|p/2 imply L_A<=C I_A+4R<=C(I_A+R), C=4+2/ln2+4/(e ln2). All actual child entropies and signed terminal component excess remain. Minimizing labelled directional cost ell(v)=w(v)+2gamma(v) by a greedy independent basis guarantees rho_L>=0; rho_L>=u suffices to fund all crossing flux from unused release. At an input-influence-minimal root that optimizer has rho=gamma_all=0. Actual activated bent functions F_k=1-A_k-A_k*(-1)^(ab+cd), k>=2, with shear a<-a+c, have full affine span, minimum affine influence, rho=0 and gamma_all=2^-k/8>0, refuting free crossing funding by rho alone. Universal block/fragment selection and full FEI are not asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform Boolean cube; n>=2 for proper-block maximum; p>0 for conditional normalization; entropy in bits
Labels are the original actual components before reset, retained in every actual child
Reset is invertible affine INPUT change only, no character multiplication; its ordinary release is nonnegative where used as funding
The old debit u is retained, and only R=rho-u is available; require2gamma_A<=R and the stated W threshold
Critical exclusion at K>=C assumes least essential dimension among positive K-violations, so every reset/query child is eligible

proof_dependencies.used_scope: universal sign/raw transfer and row bound; independent of component geometry

refutes: Unregistered helper2gamma_all<=rho for arbitrary influence-nonincreasing input resets; explicit activated bent witness
